prose: Dwarkesh Patel's argument (video version of his essay): smarter AI models could drive compute prices up 10x - the end of cheap compute. The intuition is that more capable models make each unit of compute more valuable, so demand-side pressure, not just supply constraints, reprices the market.
The post is the video recording of the piece; the written original is linked from it. (The page content is mostly podcast-player scaffolding; this summary is based on the post's framing text.)
highlights: Dwarkesh: smarter models could drive compute prices up 10x
The mechanism: capability raises the value of each unit of compute
Framed as 'the end of cheap compute?'
